subject.title: Bug: private QA commands touch operator state before isolation

question: Should private `openclaw qa` commands have a hard startup-isolation policy that bypasses operator config/state migration and plugin preloading before the QA runtime creates temporary state?
rationale: The report concerns a real-state boundary, and the correct scope of any CLI pre-action exemption must be confirmed by the owner before implementation.

options.title: Enforce private QA isolation
options.body: Treat the QA namespace as an isolated launcher and move all required setup into its temporary QA runtime boundary.

options.title: Keep shared preflight intentionally
options.body: Retain the existing global preflight only if maintainers document why private QA must access operator state and provide a safe opt-out path.

recommendation.title: Enforce private QA isolation
recommendation.body: Treat the QA namespace as an isolated launcher and move all required setup into its temporary QA runtime boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the current reproduction and boundary analysis needed to validate the intended isolation contract.
